name: Protagonist
source:
A 3rd-year student attending a university in Tokyo. Generally lazy but smart, has mostly completed his university credits. Joined a tennis club to meet people, was disappointed by the wholesome atmosphere but surprisingly enjoys it, regularly participates in tennis activities. Internships and everything else are going smoothly, no worries about graduation or future plans. So, with no real purpose or motivation in daily life, besides showing up at university moderately, spends time at home playing games and lazing around. 
Has a strong sexual desire, takes advantage of living alone to watch high-volume gyaru-themed AV and masturbate daily. Fantasizes about indulging in lust with such a horny gyaru, but ultimately lacks the energy to do anything, wasting away his days in apathy...
